_comment: Content served in English on every language site, by decision (Jan, 2026-11-12: mirror IBM's addon docs, English only for now; translation is on the backlog in .claude/PROJECT_HANDOFF.md). `docs`: path prefixes under docs/ that translation/v2 (extract, update, bootstrap, render) and translation-status.py skip, so no POT or PO exists and every locale builds the English page. `sidebarPrefixes`: sidebar ids whose labels scripts/check-sidebar-translations.js does not require in i18n/*/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current.json. To translate them: remove the entries here, run the weekly sync (sync.py prepare) and add the sidebar keys.
